unit_cn: Unit 3 Diverse Cultures 多元文化
source: 人教版2019必修三 Unit 3 词表(真词,跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、多元文化/旧金山唐人街/移民/民族村寨主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: San Francisco is a city with many diverse cultures.
words.example_cn: 旧金山是一座拥有多元文化的城市。

words.example_en: The cultural diversity of the city makes it special.
words.example_cn: 这座城市的文化多样性使它与众不同。

words.meaning_cn: 民族的;种族的;有民族特色的
words.example_en: Guizhou is home to many ethnic minority groups.
words.example_cn: 贵州是许多少数民族群体的家园。

words.meaning_cn: 少数民族;少数派;少数人
words.example_en: We visited several ethnic minority villages in Guizhou.
words.example_cn: 我们参观了贵州的几个少数民族村寨。

words.example_en: Many Chinese immigrants settled in San Francisco's Chinatown.
words.example_cn: 许多华人移民在旧金山唐人街定居下来。

words.example_en: Immigrants from many countries settled in this district.
words.example_cn: 来自许多国家的移民在这个区定居。

words.example_en: Some immigrants opened shops to earn a living.
words.example_cn: 一些移民开店谋生。

words.example_en: Thousands of people came here to seek their fortune.
words.example_cn: 成千上万的人来到这里寻找致富之路。

words.example_en: During the gold rush, people hoped to make a fortune.
words.example_cn: 淘金热期间,人们都希望发大财。

words.example_en: Many people visit Yunnan to escape the cold winter.
words.example_cn: 许多人去云南是为了躲避寒冷的冬天。

words.example_en: The earthquake claimed thousands of lives in 1906.
words.example_cn: 1906 年那场地震夺去了数千人的生命。

words.example_en: A terrible earthquake occurred in San Francisco in 1906.
words.example_cn: 1906 年旧金山发生了一场可怕的地震。

words.example_en: The museum showed the historical changes in California.
words.example_cn: 这座博物馆展示了加利福尼亚的历史变迁。

words.meaning_cn: 在市中心;往市中心;市中心的
words.example_en: My hotel is near downtown, in an old part of the city.
words.example_cn: 我的旅馆靠近市中心,在城里一个古老的区域。

words.example_en: The street art here is influenced by graffiti art.
words.example_cn: 这里的街头艺术受到了涂鸦艺术的影响。

words.meaning_cn: 滑稽的;漫画杂志;喜剧演员
words.example_en: The Mission School style mixes graffiti and comic art.
words.example_cn: “密遜画派”风格融合了涂鸦与漫画艺术。

words.example_en: I selected a Cantonese restaurant in Chinatown for dinner.
words.example_cn: 我在唐人街挑了一家粤菜馆吃晚饭。

words.example_en: A series of fires followed the great earthquake.
words.example_cn: 大地震之后接连发生了一系列火灾。

words.example_en: A large percentage of the city was destroyed by the fires.
words.example_cn: 城市的很大一部分被大火摧毁了。

words.example_en: He tried hard to solve his financial problems.
words.example_cn: 他努力解决自己的经济问题。

words.example_en: Chinese immigrants worked during the railroad construction.
words.example_cn: 华人移民在铁路修建期间工作。

words.example_en: The rebuilt area was made to contain lots of Chinese architecture.
words.example_cn: 重建的区域被设计成包含大量中式建筑。

words.example_en: The Dragon Gate was built using materials donated from China.
words.example_cn: 龙门是用从中国捐赠的材料建造的。

words.example_en: Justin wanted to buy some hand-made accessories as souvenirs.
words.example_cn: 贾斯汀想买些手工饰品作纪念品。

words.example_en: The stores offer souvenirs, goods, and clothing.
words.example_cn: 这些商店出售纪念品、商品和服装。

words.example_en: All kinds of Chinese herbal medicine can be found here.
words.example_cn: 在这里能找到各种中草药。

words.example_en: The climate is mild all year round in Chinatown.
words.example_cn: 唐人街全年气候温和。

words.example_en: A mild climate makes it a good time to visit all year.
words.example_cn: 温和的气候使这里全年都适合游览。

words.meaning_cn: 适合;满足……需要;西服;套装
words.example_en: There is Chinese food here to suit everyone's taste.
words.example_cn: 这里有适合各种口味的中餐。

words.example_en: Gumbo is a spicy stew invented in New Orleans.
words.example_cn: 秋葵汤是一种发明于新奥尔良的辛辣炖菜。

words.example_en: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous and some are not.
words.example_cn: 有些野生蘑菇有毒,有些则没有。

words.example_en: You should never eat a poisonous mushroom.
words.example_cn: 你绝不能吃有毒的蘑菇。

words.example_en: Some plants contain a poison that can harm people.
words.example_cn: 有些植物含有能伤害人的毒素。

words.example_en: I really like that paper folding book, and so does my son.
words.example_cn: 我很喜欢那本折纸书,我儿子也喜欢。

words.meaning_cn: 项目;一件商品;一条(新闻)
words.example_en: Each item on the Chinatown menu tells a small story.
words.example_cn: 唐人街菜单上的每道菜都讲述着一个小故事。

words.example_en: The instrument is mentioned in the oldest collection of Chinese poetry.
words.example_cn: 这种乐器在最古老的中国诗歌总集中被提到过。

words.example_en: The museum has a large collection of historical items.
words.example_cn: 这座博物馆收藏了大量历史物品。

words.example_en: Li Lan wrote a travel journal about her trip to San Francisco.
words.example_cn: 李兰写了一篇关于旧金山之行的旅行日志。

words.example_en: The Huangguoshu Waterfall is definitely worth visiting.
words.example_cn: 黄果树瀑布确实值得一去。

words.example_en: He arranged all the souvenirs in a neat row.
words.example_cn: 他把所有纪念品摆成整齐的一排。

words.example_en: You can draw a diagram to organise the information in the journal.
words.example_cn: 你可以画一张示意图来梳理日志中的信息。

words.example_en: Justin was super excited about his trip to Guizhou.
words.example_cn: 贾斯汀对去贵州的旅行感到超级兴奋。

words.example_en: A dress might look better than jeans and boots tonight.
words.example_cn: 今晚连衣裙也许比牛仔裤和靴子更好看。

words.meaning_cn: 炸薯片;炸土豆条;芯片;碎片
words.example_en: Nachos are corn chips covered in cheese.
words.example_cn: 墨西哥玉米片是裹上奶酪的玉米片。

words.example_en: The corn chips were covered in warm cheese.
words.example_cn: 玉米片裹上了温热的奶酪。

words.example_en: The restaurant served its food on beautiful china plates.
words.example_cn: 这家餐馆用精美的瓷盘上菜。
